crl_check_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between CRL (Certificate Revocation List) reloads. Set to 0 to disable automatic refresh.

charon_debug.description: Debug level for Charon daemon components (IKEv2). Format: '<component> <level>, ...'. Levels: 0 (none) to 4 (raw).

strict_crl_policy.description: If true, reject certificates if CRL is missing or expired. If false, allow operation with warnings.

nat_traversal.description: Enable NAT traversal (NAT-T) to support IPsec behind NAT devices.

dpd_action.description: Action taken when a peer is detected as dead. Common values: 'clear' (remove SA), 'restart', 'hold'.

dpd_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a DPD response before declaring peer dead.

ike_lifetime.description: IKE SA lifetime in seconds (before rekeying).

key_lifetime.description: IPsec (CHILD) SA lifetime in seconds (before rekeying).

connections.description: List of IPsec connection definitions (tunnels). Each item describes a single VPN tunnel or roadwarrior configuration.

name.description: Unique name of the connection (used in CLI commands and logs).

type.description: Connection type. 'tunnel' for site-to-site, 'transport' for host-to-host, 'drop' to block traffic, 'pass' to bypass IPsec.

ike_version.description: IKE version: '1' (IKEv1), '2' (IKEv2), or '0' (auto-negotiate). IKEv2 recommended for most use cases.

esp_suite.description: ESP encryption and integrity algorithm suite (e.g., 'aes256gcm16-sha256-modp3072').

auth_by.description: Authentication method. 'pubkey' (X.509), 'psk' (pre-shared key), or EAP methods (e.g., 'eap-tls').

left.description: Local IP address, interface name, or %defaultroute (auto-select). For gateways, use fixed IP.

left_id.description: Local identity (e.g., @vpn.example.com or IP address). Required for IKEv1 Aggressive Mode or when identity ≠ IP.

left_subnet.description: Local protected subnets (comma-separated list). For roadwarriors, usually includes only 0.0.0.0/0 (all).

left_cert.description: Filename of local certificate (under /etc/ipsec.d/certs/). Required for public key authentication.

right.description: Remote peer IP, FQDN, or %any (for dynamic clients).

right_id.description: Expected remote identity (e.g., @vpn.example.com or %any to skip validation).

right_sourceip.description: Virtual IP pool or subnet for remote clients (e.g., '10.10.10.0/24'). Only for roadwarrior/EAP setups.

eap_identity.description: EAP identity to request from the peer (e.g., '%identity' for user-supplied).

dpd_action.description: Override global DPD action for this connection only. Empty = use global value.

dpd_delay.description: Override global DPD delay for this connection. Empty = use global value.

dpd_timeout.description: Override global DPD timeout for this connection. Empty = use global value.
